'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Justin Desai LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
